shortDescription: HSBC LSE:HSBA, LSE:HSBA said on Wednesday it had issued $4.25 billion of senior unsecured notes in two tranches maturing in 2032 and 2037.

children: said on Wednesday it had issued $4.25 billion of senior unsecured notes in two tranches maturing in 2032 and 2037.
HSBC, Europe's largest bank, issued $1.75 billion of 5.819% fixed-rate/floating-rate senior unsecured notes due 2032
It also issued $2.5 billion of 6.262% fixed-rate/floating-rate senior unsecured notes due 2037
HSBC said it would apply to list the notes on the New York Stock Exchange
The bank did not disclose how it plans to use the proceeds
